GRAMMAR 2, 11-UNIT MAShQLAR, 4-BET + REVISION 1-11 (57-bet, PDF 56). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '11'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) 'Match Column A to Column B, to make sentences.' A: 1 If she ate a lot, 2 If John slept more, 3 If we went to the beach, 4 If Sara learned Polish, 5 If I had free time, 6 If Carl bought a car, 7 If Michelle travelled to Scotland, 8 If she drank some water, 9 If we cleaned the house, 10 If they were bored. B: a we would build a sandcastle. b I would take painting lessons. c she wouldn't be thirsty. d they would go to the circus. e he could drive to work. f she could be overweight. g it wouldn't be dirty. h he wouldn't be tired. i she would travel to Warsaw. j she would visit Loch Ness. Namuna: 1 → f.
10) 'Follow the arrows and make sentences, as in the example.' ZANJIR: go/university → study medicine → become/doctor → work for 'Doctors Without Frontiers' → travel around/world → treat sick people from different parts of the world. If I went to university, I would study medicine.
'Revision: Units 1 - 11':
11) 'Correct the mistakes, as in the example.' 1 Look at the magician. He's go to do a trick. → going 2 Mrs Richards are not a farmer. 3 Gary use to play a lot of video games. 4 How did you burn you?

O'NG USTUN:
5 Linda was drink a cup of tea when the cat scratched her. 6 The swimming pool be cleaned every month. 7 Ralph's behaviour is much worst than Dave's. 8 Annie was scared when the lights go out. 9 They are leave for Paris on Tuesday. 10 The telephone has invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
12) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 What time does Ann ...... chemistry? A have B has C had. 2 Jane ...... painting the kitchen yesterday afternoon. A isn't B were C wasn't. 3 How ...... bread is there in the bread basket? A many B much C some. 4 Ken ...... already finished the ironing when I got home. A has B will C had. 5 ...... you have to wear a uniform when you were a student? A Do B Did C Does. 6 Is the Pacific the ...... ocean in the world? A larger B large C largest. 7 When I graduate from university, I ...... start working at my father's company. A will B am C have. 8 Have you ever ...... your leg? A broke B broken C break. 9 "Who was Frankenstein ...... by?" "Mary Shelley." A written B wrote C write. 10 There isn't ...... petrol in the car to go for a drive. A too B enough C many. 11 What ...... the Eiffel Tower made of? A has B be C is.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '57'.

exercises.instructionEn: Follow the arrows and make sentences, as in the example. Chain: go/university → study medicine → become/doctor → work for 'Doctors Without Frontiers' → travel around/world → treat sick people from different parts of the world. Example: If I went to university, I would study medicine.
exercises.instructionUz: Strelkalarga ergashib gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Zanjir: universitetga borish → tibbiyot o'qish → shifokor bo'lish → 'Chegara bilmas shifokorlar' da ishlash → dunyo bo'ylab sayohat → dunyoning turli joylaridagi kasallarni davolash. Namuna: Universitetga borganimda, tibbiyot o'qirdim.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZANJIR - har natija keyingi
  shartga aylanadi.

  1 If I went to university, I
    would study medicine.
  2 If I studied medicine, I would
    become a doctor.
  3 If I became a doctor, I would
    work for 'Doctors Without
    Frontiers'.
  4 If I worked for 'Doctors
    Without Frontiers', I would
    travel around the world.
  5 If I travelled around the
    world, I would treat sick
    people from different parts of
    the world.


⚠ 'DOCTORS WITHOUT FRONTIERS':

  = 'Chegara bilmas shifokorlar'
  (xalqaro tibbiy tashkilot).
exercises.exampleEn: If I went to university, I would study medicine.
modelAnswers: 1 If I went to university, I would study medicine.
2 If I studied medicine, I would become a doctor.
3 If I became a doctor, I would work for 'Doctors Without Frontiers'.
4 If I worked for 'Doctors Without Frontiers', I would travel around the world.
5 If I travelled around the world, I would treat sick people from different parts of the world.
modelAnswersUz: 4 U yerda ishlaganimda, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilardim.
5 Dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilganimda, turli joylardagi kasallarni davolardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. Example: Look at the magician. He's go to do a trick. → going
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni tuzating, namunadagidek. Namuna: Look at the magician. He's go to do a trick. → going
exercises.explanationUz:
1-11-UNITLAR XATOLARI.

  1 go → GOING (going to)
  2 are → IS (Mrs Richards)
  3 use → USED to
  4 you → YOURSELF (o'zlik)
  5 was drink → WAS DRINKING
  6 be cleaned → IS cleaned
  7 worst → WORSE (than)
  8 go out → WENT out (o'tgan)
  9 are leave → ARE LEAVING
  10 has invented → WAS INVENTED
     (majhul)


⚠ 'A MAGICIAN':

  = sehrgar (fokuschi).


⚠ 'TO SCRATCH':

  = tirnamoq.

patterns.formula: If + KIM + V2, KIM + would / could / wouldn't + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If Carl bought a car, he could drive to work. If she drank some water, she wouldn't be thirsty.
patterns.exampleUz: Karl mashina sotib olganda, ishga mashinada bora olardi. U suv ichganda, chanqamagan bo'lardi.

patterns.formula: If I + V2 + A, I would + B. If I + V2 + B, I would + C. (zanjir)
patterns.exampleEn: If I went to university, I would study medicine. If I studied medicine, I would become a doctor.
patterns.exampleUz: Universitetga borganimda, tibbiyot o'qirdim. Tibbiyot o'qiganimda, shifokor bo'lardim.
